objective: CxC Decisión/Análisis Gate 2 — Lineage & Collections. Cerrar con evidencia SQL cinco preguntas: (1) campo/fórmula canónica de saldo en Venta_Encabezado; (2) fecha de vencimiento real por documento; (3) tablas de pagos/cobros y cómo reducen saldo; (4) existencia de historial de cobranza/promesas fuera de nombres obvios; (5) fórmula de crédito disponible sin doble contar ventas, pagos ni cancelados. No DDL/DML, no Mongo, no LIVE externo, no Producción.

queries.name: venta_encabezado_full_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Venta_Encabezado') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: venta_encabezado_constraints_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT i.name AS object_name,'INDEX' AS object_type,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.indexes i LEFT JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id LEFT JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=i.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Venta_Encabezado') AND i.is_hypothetical=0 UNION ALL SELECT cc.name,'CHECK_CONSTRAINT',0,0,NULL,0 FROM sys.check_constraints cc WHERE cc.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Venta_Encabezado') ORDER BY object_type,object_name,key_ordinal

queries.name: venta_encabezado_check_definitions
queries.sql: SELECT cc.name AS constraint_name,cc.definition FROM sys.check_constraints cc WHERE cc.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Venta_Encabezado') ORDER BY cc.name

queries.name: saldo_writer_dependencies
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,sm.definition FROM sys.sql_modules sm JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=sm.object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE sm.definition LIKE '%Venta_Encabezado%' AND (sm.definition LIKE '%SaldoPendiente%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%Saldo%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%MontoPagado%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%Cobro%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%Pago%') ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name

queries.name: due_date_dependencies
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,sm.definition FROM sys.sql_modules sm JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=sm.object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE sm.definition LIKE '%Venta_Encabezado%' AND (sm.definition LIKE '%Venc%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%DiasCredito%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%CondicionPago%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%Fecha%') ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name

queries.name: payment_collection_candidate_tables
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Cobro%' OR t.name LIKE '%Pago%' OR t.name LIKE '%Abono%' OR t.name LIKE '%Aplicacion%' OR t.name LIKE '%Recibo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Deposito%' OR t.name LIKE '%Venta%Pago%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cliente%Pago%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name

queries.name: payment_collection_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE (t.name LIKE '%Cobro%' OR t.name LIKE '%Pago%' OR t.name LIKE '%Abono%' OR t.name LIKE '%Aplicacion%' OR t.name LIKE '%Recibo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Deposito%' OR t.name LIKE '%Venta%Pago%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cliente%Pago%') AND (c.name LIKE '%Venta%' OR c.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR c.name LIKE '%Documento%' OR c.name LIKE '%Factura%' OR c.name LIKE '%Monto%' OR c.name LIKE '%Importe%' OR c.name LIKE '%Saldo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Fecha%' OR c.name LIKE '%Estado%' OR c.name LIKE '%Estatus%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: payment_collection_fk_paths
queries.sql: SELECT pt.name AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,fk.name AS fk_name,rt.name AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.tables pt ON pt.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=pt.object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables rt ON rt.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=rt.object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE pt.name LIKE '%Cobro%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Pago%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Abono%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Aplicacion%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Recibo%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Deposito%' OR rt.name='Venta_Encabezado' OR rt.name='Cliente_Catalogo' ORDER BY pt.name,fk.name

queries.name: collections_history_semantic_modules
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,sm.definition FROM sys.sql_modules sm JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=sm.object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE sm.definition LIKE '%ClienteID%' AND (sm.definition LIKE '%promesa%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%cobranza%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%contacto%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%seguimiento%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%compromiso%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%mora%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%vencid%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%gestion%') ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name

queries.name: collections_history_semantic_columns
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE (c.name LIKE '%Promesa%' OR c.name LIKE '%Cobranza%' OR c.name LIKE '%Contacto%' OR c.name LIKE '%Seguimiento%' OR c.name LIKE '%Compromiso%' OR c.name LIKE '%Mora%' OR c.name LIKE '%Venc%' OR c.name LIKE '%Gestion%') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns cx WHERE cx.object_id=t.object_id AND (cx.name='ClienteID' OR cx.name LIKE '%Cliente%')) ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: credit_limit_source
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.is_nullable,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Cliente_Catalogo') AND (c.name LIKE '%Limite%' OR c.name LIKE '%Credito%' OR c.name LIKE '%Bloque%' OR c.name LIKE '%Estado%' OR c.name LIKE '%Activo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Condicion%') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: credit_available_dependencies
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,sm.definition FROM sys.sql_modules sm JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=sm.object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE sm.definition LIKE '%Cliente_Catalogo%' AND (sm.definition LIKE '%LimiteCredito%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%credito disponible%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%SaldoPendiente%' OR sm.definition LIKE '%Venta_Encabezado%') ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name

queries.name: venta_status_signals
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Venta_Encabezado') AND (c.name LIKE '%Estado%' OR c.name LIKE '%Estatus%' OR c.name LIKE '%Cancel%' OR c.name LIKE '%Activo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Pag%' OR c.name LIKE '%Saldo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Total%' OR c.name LIKE '%Fecha%') ORDER BY c.column_id
